#!/bin/sh
set -u

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
pidfile=$base/run/worker.pid
worker=$base/worker.py
lockfile=$base/run/control.lock

umask 022
mkdir -p "$base/run"
exec 9>"$lockfile"
if ! flock -x 9; then
    printf '%s\n' "cannot lock $lockfile" >&2
    exit 1
fi

pid=
state=absent

valid_pid()
{
    case $pid in
        ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;;
    esac
    [ "$pid" -gt 1 ] 2>/dev/null
}

is_worker()
{
    check_pid=$1
    [ -r "/proc/$check_pid/cmdline" ] || return 1
    arg1=$({ tr '\000' '\n' < "/proc/$check_pid/cmdline"; } 2>/dev/null | sed -n '2p')
    [ "$arg1" = "$worker" ]
}

classify()
{
    pid=
    if [ ! -f "$pidfile" ]; then
        state=absent
        return
    fi

    IFS= read -r pid < "$pidfile" || :
    if ! valid_pid || [ ! -d "/proc/$pid" ]; then
        state=stale
    elif is_worker "$pid"; then
        state=worker
    else
        state=foreign
    fi
}

start_worker()
{
    classify
    case $state in
        worker)
            printf 'worker already running (pid %s)\n' "$pid"
            return 0
            ;;
        stale)
            printf 'removing stale pid file (pid %s)\n' "${pid:-invalid}"
            rm -f -- "$pidfile"
            ;;
        foreign)
            printf 'pid %s belongs to another process; replacing unsafe pid file\n' "$pid"
            rm -f -- "$pidfile"
            ;;
        absent)
            ;;
    esac

    nohup python "$worker" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    newpid=$!
    tmp=$pidfile.$$
    if ! printf '%s\n' "$newpid" > "$tmp" || ! mv -f -- "$tmp" "$pidfile"; then
        rm -f -- "$tmp"
        kill "$newpid" 2>/dev/null || :
        printf '%s\n' 'could not write worker pid file' >&2
        return 1
    fi

    i=0
    while [ "$i" -lt 20 ]; do
        if is_worker "$newpid"; then
            printf 'worker started (pid %s)\n' "$newpid"
            return 0
        fi
        kill -0 "$newpid" 2>/dev/null || break
        sleep 0.1
        i=$((i + 1))
    done

    rm -f -- "$pidfile"
    printf 'worker failed to start (pid %s)\n' "$newpid" >&2
    return 1
}

stop_worker()
{
    classify
    case $state in
        absent)
            printf '%s\n' 'worker is not running'
            return 0
            ;;
        stale)
            printf 'removing stale pid file (pid %s); worker is not running\n' "${pid:-invalid}"
            rm -f -- "$pidfile"
            return 0
            ;;
        foreign)
            printf 'pid %s belongs to another process; not sending a signal\n' "$pid" >&2
            rm -f -- "$pidfile"
            return 2
            ;;
        worker)
            kill "$pid"
            i=0
            while [ "$i" -lt 50 ]; do
                if ! is_worker "$pid"; then
                    rm -f -- "$pidfile"
                    printf 'worker stopped (pid %s)\n' "$pid"
                    return 0
                fi
                sleep 0.1
                i=$((i + 1))
            done
            printf 'worker did not stop after SIGTERM (pid %s)\n' "$pid" >&2
            return 1
            ;;
    esac
}

status_worker()
{
    classify
    case $state in
        worker)
            printf 'worker is running (pid %s)\n' "$pid"
            return 0
            ;;
        stale)
            printf 'worker is not running; stale pid file contains %s\n' "${pid:-invalid}"
            return 1
            ;;
        foreign)
            printf 'worker is not running; pid %s belongs to another process\n' "$pid"
            return 2
            ;;
        absent)
            printf '%s\n' 'worker is not running; no pid file'
            return 3
            ;;
    esac
}

case ${1-} in
    start) start_worker ;;
    stop) stop_worker ;;
    status) status_worker ;;
    *)
        printf 'usage: %s {start|stop|status}\n' "$0" >&2
        exit 64
        ;;
esac
